title: Noetherianity and finite presentation on the closed fibre
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring and let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of local rings which is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Let $\mathfrak m_A$ be the maximal ideal of $A$. Then $B/\mathfrak m_A B$ is a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and for every finite $B$-module $N$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], the quotient $N/\mathfrak m_A N$ is finitely presented as a module over $B/\mathfrak m_A B$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].

source.place: Tag 0GSG (lemma-mod-injective-valuation-ring), proof, second paragraph: $N/\mathfrak m_A N$ is of finite presentation over the Noetherian ring $B/\mathfrak m_A B$
